APPROVE
The new `||` short-circuit and `is not { } entry` pattern keep the original filtering order and definite assignment, and the extracted helpers carry the same logic verbatim, which removes about 11 or more nested-complexity points and brings `ParsePodfileLock` under 15 with behaviour and compilation preserved. I judged this from the diff alone without building, so the method's original return type and the unchanged `JoinDirectWithResolved` tail are assumed to fit the new signature.
